source_records.title: Data from: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
source_records.stated_scope: Associated supplementary data and analysis scripts for a study of 250 commercial beers; article reports over 200 chemical features and trained-panel descriptors.
restricted_components: RateBeer review scores are stated as restricted in the paper; exclude without separate permission.
source_records.use_gate: Record exact file names, license/terms, SHA-256, stable sample identifiers, units and missingness before adapter implementation.
claims_not_supported: new-brewery generalization unless group identifiers support it

source_records.title: Wine Quality
source_records.license: CC BY 4.0 as stated by UCI
source_records.use_gate: Record exact archive version and SHA-256; preserve red/white label; use only for a separate static chemistry-to-score baseline.

source_records.title: 2025 Water, Energy, and Emissions Benchmarking Summary
source_records.published_scope: BIER reports over 1600 facilities across the 2020, 2022 and 2024 reporting years, stratified by facility type.
source_records.use_gate: Use as a facility-type-aware comparison reference; do not assume the public summary is a row-level training dataset.
claims_not_supported: causal savings attributable to our optimizer
universal per-liter target across facility types

published_results.water_risk_context: more than 60% of facilities face at least medium water risk; more than half projected to face medium-to-extremely-high water stress by 2030
published_results.caveat: Aggregate sector ratios across reporting facilities; not a matched causal baseline for a single-site intervention or a universal target.

source_records.title: Standardized alcoholic-fermentation sensor time-series candidates
source_records.stated_gap: A 2026 review identifies a lack of public standardized fermentation sensor datasets and limited industrial validation.
source_records.use_gate: Audit and record candidate datasets; this review finding is not proof that no relevant public dataset exists.

source_records.title: Fermentation temperature as a strategy to limit Hanseniaspora uvarum proliferation during spontaneous wine fermentation
source_records.license: CC0 as stated in Dryad README

dataset_tables.described_target: Growth of Hanseniaspora uvarum and Saccharomyces cerevisiae, alone and co-inoculated, in chemically defined grape juice; long-form fields include time, treatment temperature, inoculation, analyte, units, replicate and value.
Microbial dynamics of spontaneous Chardonnay must fermentation at 17, 23 and 25 °C.
Freeze-thaw effects on spontaneous Chardonnay fermentation and yeast population; fields include treatment, time_hours, analyte, units, replicate and value.

source_records.use_gate: Download exact files and README; record file SHA-256, delimiters/headers, NA and ND semantics, units, treatment/replicate structure, analyte families, and whether replicates are biological or technical. Group splits at the fermentation/treatment unit; never treat each time row as independent.
caveats: The web preview exposed file names and metadata but returned 403 for direct file streams; exact source bytes and hashes have not been captured in this pass.
175, 121 and 334 are the raw table row counts, not counts of independent fermentation batches.

source_records.title: Evaluation of wine fermentation dynamics through kinetic analysis
source_records.license: Article states Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY); inspect supplementary files/terms individually
source_records.stated_scope: Published Brix and ethanol time courses over 0–168 h across selected yeast-inoculum, 20/25/30 °C, initial-sugar and yeast-pre-propagation conditions; paper reports triplicate experiments and propagated uncertainty.
source_records.use_gate: Acquire article and supplementary material, preserve table definitions and uncertainty, reconstruct reported kinetic quantities, and compare simple and nonlinear baselines. Do not count triplicates or timepoints as independent external batches.

source_records.title: Lager beer fermentation time course transcriptome
source_records.stated_scope: Archived production-scale lager fermentation yeast transcriptome measured at 12 time points.
source_records.rights_status: PUBLIC_ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE; VERIFY GEO RECORD AND TERMS
source_records.use_gate: Pin official GEO sample/platform records and raw/processed file hashes. Treat transcript counts/expressions as biological-state observations; do not conflate with inline temperature, gravity, ethanol, quality or sensory targets.
claims_not_supported: direct finished-beer quality prediction without target linkage
generalization from one time course to multiple breweries

source_records.title: Synthetic Beer Fermentation Dataset Generation and Hybrid MSPC-ML Case Study in R
source_records.publisher: Zenodo record; Francesch-Domenech, Fernandez-Calviño, Naya-Fernández and Tarrío
source_records.stated_scope: Research code and synthetic beer-fermentation data generation, fault injection, PCA-based multivariate statistical process control, XGBoost classification and SHAP interpretation.
source_records.use_gate: Use for evaluator smoke tests and synthetic anomaly-detector comparisons only after record/license audit; keep synthetic provenance encoded in every output.

source_records.title: Critical assessment of machine learning approaches for classification, dynamic prediction and surrogate modeling in food fermentation
source_records.license: Open access under a Creative Commons license; confirm exact article/supplement terms before reuse
source_records.results_context: Study-specific results: knowledge-based and ML dynamic-prediction comparisons use experimental time-series data; the approximately 0.6% surrogate result is fidelity to the knowledge-based model on synthetic test cases, not real-world fermentation measurement error.
source_records.use_gate: Reproduce the published data definitions, split strategy, uncertainty and baseline values first. Separate empirical NRMSE from synthetic simulator-fidelity error; compare on same inputs, targets and test units. Treat the hybrid residual network as a candidate, not a presumed winner.
claims_not_supported: universal superiority of mechanistic or ML models

research_notes: Public process-related time-course data exist in research repositories; the gap is not absolute absence but fragmented formats, limited numbers of independent fermentation units, heterogeneous targets, and few standardized industrial sensor streams with aligned batch IDs and quality outcomes.
Primary intake candidate: Dryad 2026 CC0 wine-temperature/yeast-ecology files, after raw-byte and replicate-structure audit.
Separate curve-reproduction candidate: 2026 Frontiers wine-kinetics article and supplement; table/uncertainty reproduction is not external validation.
Transcriptome time courses are biological evidence, not direct process-sensor or final-quality targets.
Synthetic fermentation data are for pipeline and fault-injection tests only.
